summary: Add st-test --out DIR to export evidence packs for a separate publisher, including ordinary, aggregate, per-crate and seed runs.

replay.detail: No event replay or stored event changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: The source st-test runner accepts --out DIR, mutually exclusive with --push. It forwards an absolute directory to evidence-wrap and reruns the selected relevant checks, including covered crates, for a complete export. Existing non-export signing and verification behavior is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service restart or interruption is required.

manual.detail: For a separate publisher, use --out DIR instead of --push REMOTE. Seed export does not implicitly push. Export success means passing checks and written packs, not verified coverage; publish and verify the exported records separately.

recovery.detail: No data migration or recovery procedure changes. Existing invocations without --out retain their behavior; stop using --out before rolling back the source runner.
